definitions.gloss: lunch bag; bento bag; lunch pouch
definitions.explanation: A small bag or pouch designed to carry a bento box, typically insulated or made of cloth.

examples.japanese: {子|こ}ども⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{弁当袋|べんとうぶくろ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{手作|てづく}り→手作り：08300_tezukuri⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I handmade a lunch bag for my child.

examples.japanese: {保冷|ほれい}⟦タイプ→タイプ：01534_taipu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{弁当袋|べんとうぶくろ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{夏場|なつば}→夏場：28060_natsuba⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{便利|べんり}→便利：00830_benri⟧だ。
examples.english: An insulated lunch bag is handy in summer.

examples.japanese: ⟦{入学|にゅうがく}→入学：02092_nyuugaku⟧⟦{準備|じゅんび}→準備：01431_junbi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{弁当箱|べんとうばこ}→弁当箱：20186_bentoubako⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{弁当袋|べんとうぶくろ}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{水筒|すいとう}→水筒：04299_suitou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{買|か}い{揃|そろ}えた。
examples.english: In preparation for school enrollment, I bought a bento box, lunch bag, and water bottle.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{弁当|べんとう}→弁当：01014_bentou⟧ (boxed lunch, bento) and {袋|ぶくろ} (bag). In Japan, carrying a homemade bento to school or work is common, and a dedicated {弁当袋|べんとうぶくろ} is a standard item.

For children starting school, parents often make or buy matching sets of {弁当袋|べんとうぶくろ}, ⟦{弁当箱|べんとうばこ}→弁当箱：20186_bentoubako⟧ (lunch box), and ⟦{箸|はし}→箸：01026_hashi⟧⟦ケース→ケース：03841_keesu⟧ (chopstick case). Handmade lunch bags (⟦{手作|てづく}り→手作り：08300_tezukuri⟧) are a tradition at many Japanese elementary schools.
